description: Search the Texas Comptroller's Franchise Tax Account Status registry by entity name, Comptroller taxpayer number, or Texas Secretary of State file number.

entityName.description: Business name to search for (2-50 characters). Partial/starts-with matches are returned by the registry.
entityName.title: Entity name (mode=byName)

fetchDetails.description: When mode=byName, fetch the full account-status record (registered agent, addresses, officers) for each match instead of just the name/taxpayer ID summary. Adds one extra request per match.
fetchDetails.title: Fetch full details for name-search results

maxOfficers.description: Cap on how many officers/directors to include per business record.
maxOfficers.title: Max officers/directors per record

enumTitles: Lookup by Texas SOS file number
mode.title: Mode

sosFileNumbers.description: Texas Secretary of State filing numbers.
sosFileNumbers.title: SOS file numbers (mode=bySosFileNumber)
